definition: **Bonus** is a share in profits or productivity-linked payment under the Wages Code (formerly Payment of Bonus Act). Eligible employees in covered establishments receive **minimum bonus** (even if no allocable surplus) and **maximum** cap linked to salary ceiling; **set-on/set-off** of surplus/deficiency across accounting years applies.

statutoryReferences.note: Verify % minimum/maximum in bare act for your batch

examChecklist.text: Minimum bonus even without profit; **maximum** limit
